findings.item: Re-approved after expanding the CLAUDE.md Glossary entry with the managed-policy scope's exact OS paths (cited to code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, Reference tier), adding a CLAUDE.local.md entry, and wikilinking CLAUDE-file mentions across Domains 1-3 plus three previously-orphaned Glossary entries (.claude/rules/, SKILL.md, REVIEW.md) in this note.

First eval pass rejected for a load-timing self-contradiction (managed/user/project load at launch, directory loads on demand — Glossary and note now agree), an overclaimed citation footer, link-spam in Sec 3.1 (CLAUDE.md linked 4x to the same anchor), and line-wrap regressions. All fixed and re-verified: 12 flashcards, one graph TD, every task 3.1-3.6 has a trap, all wikilinks resolve.

Re-approved after linking every first-mention command/flag in this note to the new Claude Commands.md catalog (/init, /memory, /create_worktree, .claude/commands/, /review, merge_worktree, .claude/skills/, /compact, /clear, -p, --output-format, --json-schema, --bare, --resume, --append-system-prompt, --system-prompt, /code-review, --fix, /install-github-app, --max-turns), and adding a blank callout separator before the CLI-reference citation. Three review rounds caught and fixed: a broken wikilink-with-backtick-alias pattern (SKILL.md/CLAUDE.md/REVIEW.md/.claude/rules/), a factual error in the migrated /review entry (falsely claimed not a real built-in; corrected after live-doc verification), and a quarantine breach (the corrected /review entry initially cited and disclosed a specific quarantined practice-tier sample question; removed). 12 flashcards, one graph TD, trap per task 3.1-3.6, all 67+ vault-wide anchors resolve.
